author: A

components.title: Whole request
components.what:
You deposit $7,500 in an account that earns 3.6% per year, compounded monthly, and you add $350 at the end of every month. What is the balance immediately after the 84th deposit? Give the amount in dollars to the nearest cent.

Show brief working, then end your reply with exactly one line of the for

log.author: C
log.draft:
To find the future balance immediately after the 84th deposit, we use the future value formula combining a compound interest principal with an ordinary annuity:

$$FV = P(1 + i)^n + PMT \times \frac{(1 + i)^n - 1}{i}$$

Parameters:
- Initial deposit ($P$): $\$7,500$
- Monthly interest rate ($i$): $\frac{0.036}{12} = 0.003$
- Number of periods ($n$): $84$
- Regular monthly deposit ($PMT$): $\$350$

Calculating the growth factor:
$$(1 + i)^n = (1.003)^{84} \approx 1.286123471$$

1. Future value of the initial deposit:
$$FV_{\text{principal}} = 7500 \times 1.286123471 \approx 9645.926$$

2. Future value of the annuity:
$$FV_{\text{annuity}} = 350 \times \frac{1.286123471 - 1}{0.003} = 350 \times 95.374490 \approx 33381.072$$

Summing both values:
$$

This depends on the incorrect growth factor and should be approximately $33,379.589.
